response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience as a full-stack engineer with over 12 years of progressive roles, including leadership and AI-agent infrastructure work. His technical breadth spans TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud technologies, with demonstrated expertise in performance optimization, architecture, and testing. While his strongest backend skills are in JS/TS ecosystems, he has also worked with Kotlin/Java, aligning well with the secondary stack. His open-source contributions and mentorship activities further validate his depth and collaborative mindset.
strengths: Deep full-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and React, matching the primary stack requirements
Strong leadership and architecture skills demonstrated in scalable, high-traffic systems (e.g., micro-services at dunnhumby)
Proven expertise in AI-agent development and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), aligning with modern engineering trends
concerns: Limited direct experience with Nest.js, a core primary stack requirement, though he has used Node.js extensively
Primary backend experience is JavaScript/TypeScript-heavy; Kotlin/Java exposure is secondary and may require ramp-up
Some gaps in relational database experience (listed skills focus on MongoDB/SQL broadly but not PostgreSQL/MySQL specifically)
